latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic assignment and terminal-completed the native Goal after saving the artifacts.

- [critique.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M10-A/treatment/critic/critique.md) reviews every P1–P6 clause, the research and alternatives, and V1–V8; it adds V9 for record-count reconciliation.
- [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M10-A/treatment/critic/source-map.json) preserves inherited source IDs and adds C01–C14. The bounded evidence and index are in [sources/](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M10-A/treatment/critic/sources/index.md).

Key findings: keep the promised error CSV alongside an in-app issue ledger, define nonoverlapping row-count categories, and state parser location limits precisely. The versioned [Rust CSV source](https://github.com/BurntSushi/rust-csv/blob/1.4.0/src/reader.rs) and [RFC 4180](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc4180/) support those refinements. V1–V9 remain proposals; no runtime checks or benchmarks were run. Native Goal elapsed time was 6m40s.
